Name: Hyatt Regency London Stratford
Notes: Recommended base — sofa-bed family room, child free, free cancellation, ~EUR 1209/2 nights. Walk to Westfield, Olympic Park & Stratford station.

Name: The Gantry London (Curio by Hilton)
Notes: Design upgrade with rooftop bar, by the park — ~EUR 1386/2nt.

Name: InterContinental London - The O2
Notes: Alt with POOL + Junior Suite ~EUR 900/2nt; ~10 min by Jubilee/DLR; IFS cable car nearby.

Name: Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park - Tumbling Bay Playground
Notes: Brilliant adventure playground for a 5yo (sand, water, treehouses). Right by hotel.

Name: London Aquatics Centre
Notes: Olympic pool with public family swim sessions.

Name: Westfield Stratford City
Notes: Shopping + huge dining choice; wet-weather backup; car park.

Name: ArcelorMittal Orbit
Notes: Views + giant slide (slide min height 1.3m — Noah likely too small, but views fine).

Name: Natural History Museum
Notes: Dinosaurs; new 'Jurassic Oceans' exhibition from 22 May; free entry.

Name: SEA LIFE London Aquarium
Address: County Hall, Westminster Bridge Rd SE1 7PB
Notes: Next to the Eye; book ahead.

Name: Dishoom Covent Garden
Notes: Kids' menu, lively-relaxed Bombay cafe; book.

Name: Inamo Covent Garden
Notes: Interactive table screens + games — a 5yo magnet.

Name: Westfield dining (Wahaca / Franco Manca / Pizza Express)
Notes: Easy family dinner steps from the hotel.

Name: QE Olympic Park run loop
Notes: ~5km paved loop past the Stadium/Aquatics Centre + River Lea (Lee Navigation) towpath. From hotel door.
